description: Controlled vocabulary of asset ROLES for the Auxia design-repo — what job a media slot does, not a file catalog. Every role below cites the real files under /public/assets/ and the real src/ line(s) that consume them, measured directly against this repo's sibling source project. A generator picks or sources an asset FOR a role; it never invents a role. The five role ids below are exactly the five listed in tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json's assetRoles array — this file is that enum's documentation and evidence layer, not a separate list.
measuredFrom: public/assets/ directory listing (../public/assets/, 34 files across fonts/icons/img/logos plus favicon.png); `grep -rn "/assets/" ../src/` and `grep -rn "public/assets" ../src/` (2026-09-18).
enumMirroredIn: tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json → assetRoles (the closed 5-id list this file documents)
schema/pagespec.schema.json → the assetRole const on brands.marquee / demo.form logo fields
sections/brands.marquee.json, sections/demo.form.json → the assetRole-bearing content fields

logo.self.purpose: Auxia's own product wordmark/icon — the site's real, owned brand mark, shown in the navbar and footer.
logo.self.policyNote: This is the ONE real, owned mark in the project. It is safe to reproduce because Auxia's own logo — unlike the third-party customer logos below — is not someone else's IP being cloned without license.

logo.invented-wordmark.purpose: A geometric, deliberately-invented wordmark that stands in for one of the 9 real third-party customer logos the original reference site shows in its logo marquee, case-studies rail, and demo-form social-proof strip. Never a redraw or recreation of a real company's mark.
logo.invented-wordmark.aspect: 5:1, matching the real slots' aspect exactly so marquee/grid rhythm is unaffected
logo.invented-wordmark.slugNote: Contract fields carry the bare slug (e.g. 'northwind'), not a path — see sections/brands.marquee.json and sections/demo.form.json content.logos, both of which constrain assetRole to the literal const "logo.invented-wordmark".
logo.invented-wordmark.hardConstraint: MANDATORY, carried forward from ../README.md's 'Third-party material is not included' section and ../extraction/measured-values.json's licensingDecisions.invented_logos: these 9 marks belong to their real owners and are never reproduced — neither copied nor redrawn as SVG paths — anywhere a generator uses this design-repo. A generator may invent NEW original wordmarks in this same style, but must never attempt to render, approximate, or imply a real named company's actual logo, wordmark, or trademark under this role.

photo.own-team.purpose: Photography of Auxia's own team/offsite — real people who are the site's own subject, not stock or a customer's imagery.
usedAt: ../src/pages/AboutUs.jsx:152 (``)

photo.own-marketing.purpose: Auxia's own marketing/product photography and product-UI screenshots used across hero, process, stack and blog sections — landscape/lifestyle plates and real UI captures, not third-party stock or customer material.
usedAt: ../src/pages/Blog.jsx:44-100 (7 post thumbnails, all captioned 'Auxia's own imagery, downloaded to /assets/img/' at Blog.jsx:33)

diagram.generated-ui.purpose: Generated/vector line-art diagrams and icon-style illustrations — process-flow and decisioning schematics, plus small checkmark/laptop/message/person icons — that are drawn abstractions rather than photography.

fontPolicy.description: Both site typefaces are SIL Open Font License and self-hosted, carried forward as a hard constraint from ../README.md's 'Fonts' section and ../extraction/measured-values.json's licensingDecisions.self_hosted_fonts — never replaced with a font loaded from a third-party CDN (Google Fonts, Adobe Fonts, etc.) by anything a generator produces from this design-repo.

faces.note: Chosen by measurement (3.69% mean / 5.21% worst-case advance-width deviation against the reference's real commercial grotesque, tightest worst-case of 10 candidates compared) — a substitute, not the original commercial face, which is never bundled.

fontPolicy.hardConstraint: All fonts referenced by generated output must resolve to files self-hosted under public/assets/fonts/ (or an equivalent self-hosted path in a consuming project) — never an external font-hosting request.

legalCopyPolicy.description: Carried forward from ../README.md's 'Third-party material is not included' section and ../extraction/measured-values.json's licensingDecisions.placeholder_legal: /privacy-policy and /terms use representative PLACEHOLDER prose, not anyone's real legal text, and both pages render a REQUIRED, visible in-page notice saying so — verified as an actually-rendered banner, not merely a code comment.
verifiedNoticeLocations: ../src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.jsx:27 (comment: 'BODY PROSE IS PLACEHOLDER — see the banner') and its rendered role="note" banner
../src/pages/Terms.jsx:20 (comment: 'BODY PROSE IS PLACEHOLDER — see the banner') and its rendered role="note" banner
legalCopyPolicy.hardConstraint: Any generated page bound to the 'legal' template (sections/legal.prose.json) MUST render an equivalent visible in-page placeholder notice alongside placeholder body prose — a generator must never present invented legal text as real legal text with no disclosure, and must never source real third-party legal copy to fill this slot.

noOutboundLinksPolicy.description: Carried forward from ../README.md and ../extraction/measured-values.json's licensingDecisions.no_outbound_links: every link that would point at the real reference site's live properties resolves to '#' instead, and the demo form is local React state only with zero network requests.
noOutboundLinksPolicy.independentVerification: grep -rniE 'https?://|fetch\(|XMLHttpRequest|axios' across this design-repo's sibling src/ finds zero real external-request call sites — only XML namespace URIs (xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg") inside inline SVG markup, which are not network requests.
noOutboundLinksPolicy.hardConstraint: Any AI-generated content produced from this design-repo must not introduce a real outbound hyperlink or a real network request (fetch/XHR/form POST to a live endpoint). Interactive controls that would normally deep-link externally must resolve to '#' or an equivalent local no-op, exactly as the measured source does.

unreferencedOnDisk.note: Files under public/assets/ with no confirmed src/ reference found during this pass.

knownGaps: There is no alt-text registry as a separate contract layer. Decorative images in src/ use alt="" (e.g. Navbar/Footer/Trusted logo marks); images that convey real content carry real alt text inline at the call site (e.g. AboutUs.jsx:152,307) rather than in a shared data file.
This project has exactly one theme (tokens/themes/light.json, confirmed by grep — no dark: variants, no ThemeProvider). No role has a dark-mode counterpart because there is no dark mode.
